maddeler.e:
أنسحق (form VII)
# أَنْسَحِقُ (ʔansaḥiqu) /ʔan.sa.ħi.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# أَنْسَحِقَ (ʔansaḥiqa) /ʔan.sa.ħi.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
# أَنْسَحِقْ (ʔansaḥiq) /ʔan.sa.ħiq/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَحَقَ (insaḥaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
